subject: FinLytics integration & 5xx debugging / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: FinLytics integration & 5xx debugging / next steps

Alex — great talk today, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our side so we stay aligned:

- What we heard: FinLytics wants to embed Redwood for document search + a reranker/structured-output pipeline for downstream scoring. Main concerns: auth model (api key vs oauth), routing/fallback for lower-latency models, and stability at production throughput. You saw some intermittent 5xx while testing embeddings at higher batch sizes.

Action items / next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive: Dev to lead a session on SDK setup, auth patterns, and routing logic (retries, fallback model variants) — proposed Wed 2026-04-08 10:00 PT.
2) Share integration spec & sample payloads (embeddings + reranker + structured output) — attached integration_spec_v2.pdf.
3) Repro for 5xx: if you can share failing request payloads + logs we can triage (Dev will mirror your request locally & add timeouts).
4) Short-term mitigation: lower embedding batch_size to 8, increase request timeout to 60s, and enable per-customer KV caching for prefixes.

I'll schedule the deep-dive; please confirm availability and send any failing request examples.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0143

Attachment: integration_spec_v2.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: FinLytics integration & 5xx debugging / next steps

Thanks, Marissa — that all looks good. Confirming availability for the deep-dive on Wed (10:00 PT works).

Couple of quick tech clarifications before the session:
- Auth: we prefer using short-lived tokens via our own IdP (OAuth) instead of long-lived API keys for security/compliance. Is OAuth supported in the private deployment flow or is it only API-key based today?
- Routing/fallback: when we tested a higher throughput run for embeddings (batch_size 64) we saw a spike of 502/503s from the embeddings endpoint. It was reproducible locally and caused retries in our client. Any guidance on recommended batch sizes per GPU type?

I've attached a small sample log excerpt and the failing request we used (failed_payload.json). The failing request is an embeddings batch (64 items), model: rwd-embed-2048, timeout default (30s). Logs show 502 from the inference node with repeated connection resets.

We'll upload a fuller log set to the shared drive before the call.

— Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | FinLytics
alex.johnson@finlytics.com
Attachment: failed_payload.json (JSON, 12KB)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinLytics integration & 5xx debugging / next steps

Alex — thanks for the details and the payload. Two quick asks so we can reproduce locally and speed up root cause analysis:

1) Can you share the full request headers (auth header redacted is fine) + exact SDK version and client config (timeouts, retry policy, batch_size).
2) If you can capture the stack trace / request id from the 502 response that would help (or the x-request-id header if present).

In the meantime, try the following to reduce surface area: set batch_size to 8, set request timeout to 60s, and disable client retries (we'll control retries server-side once we stabilize). Example curl:

curl -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/embeddings 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-2048","input":["doc1","doc2"],"batch_size":8}'

I'll run your failed_payload locally using a small harness (attached support_repro.sh) and post logs to the ticket. If this is a transient node issue we may need infra to pin and flush the node's worker queues.

Dev Patel
Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: support_repro.sh (shell script)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2026 11:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: FinLytics integration & 5xx debugging / next steps

Dev / Marissa — attaching the fuller failing snippet and a short log excerpt. Repro steps we ran:

1) SDK: python-redwood 1.3.0, batch_size: 64, retries: 3, timeout: 30s
2) Endpoint: https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/embeddings
3) Payload: see attached failed_payload.json (64 items; fairly long documents ~2-3KB each)
4) Error: 502 Bad Gateway, repeated for ~20% of batches; x-request-id: 9f2b7a3c-84b2-4e2e-9d3b-0a6f7f2d0c9e

Log excerpt:
[2026-04-07T16:20:12Z] request_id=9f2b7a3c status=502 node=worker-23 error="connection reset by peer"
[2026-04-07T16:20:13Z] request_id=9f2b80ff status=200 node=worker-7 duration_ms=412
[2026-04-07T16:21:01Z] request_id=9f2b9f1a status=503 node=worker-4 error="timeout writing to GPU"

We also tried reducing batch_size to 16 and saw fewer failures but still some 502s. We'll be on the deep-dive tomorrow and can run interactive repros. Attaching failed_payload.json.

— Alex
Attachment: failed_payload.json (JSON, 36KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinLytics integration & 5xx debugging / next steps

Thanks, Alex — appreciate the detailed logs. Quick summary of immediate next steps so it's clear for procurement and your platform team:

- Tech: Dev & Infra will escalate INF-2153 (linked) and run the failing payloads in a pinned environment. Rishi will coordinate access and any required capacity adjustments.
- Short-term mitigation: As discussed, set batch_size to 8-16 and increase client timeout to 60s. Dev will provide patched SDK snippet for your team to test during the deep-dive.
- Auth: We support OAuth in our Private deployment; Marissa/CS to confirm exact setup checklist for FinLytics (I’ll include the private-deploy checklist in the shared drive).
- Commercial: Procurement looped; if you need a higher SLA or node pinning we can propose a Dedicated capacity add-on (I’ll follow up formally after the tech triage).

Can we confirm the deep-dive for Wed 10:00 PT? I’ll have infra on the call if we see repro during the session.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
